spans.s: पट् (I) vt. 1P (pres. पटति) To go, to move.

पट् Caus. (पाटयति-ते) 1. to split, to tear up, to tear asunder, to divide, एष पाट्यतां क्रकचेन वा Mrich.ix.; 2. to break, अन्यासु भित्तिषु मया निशि पाटितासु Mrich.iii.; 3. to pierce, to penetrate, दर्भपाटिततलेन पाणिना R.xi.31.With उद्-, 1. to tear out, दंतैर्नोत्पाटयेन्नखान् M.iv.69; 2. to pull out, to extract; 3. to eradicate.With वि-, 1. to tear, (केतकबर्हं) विपाटयामास युवा नखाग्रैः R.vi.17; 2. to pull out.
पट् (II) vt. 10U (पटयति-ते) To clothe, to envelop.
पाट् ind. An interjection used in calling.
पट (I) m.n. 1. A garment, a piece of cloth, अयं पटः सूत्रदरिद्रतां गतो ह्ययं पटश्छिद्रशतैरलंकृतः । अयं पटः संवृत एव शोभते Mrich.ii., Am.
; 2. fine cloth; 3. a veil, a screen; 4. a tablet for writing or painting.
पट (II) n. A thatch, a roof.
पट्ट m.n. 1. A slab, a tablet, a plate, Am.

; 2. a royal grant or edict; 3. a diadem, R.xviii.44; 4. a grinding stone; 5. a place where four roads meet; 6. a city, a town; 7. a throne; 8. a shield; 9. an upper garment, Bt.x.60; 10. a stool; 11. silk; 12. a bandage, a ligature (in medicine).
पट-उटज n. a tent.
पट-कार m. 1. a weaver; 2. a painter.
पट-कुटी f. a tent.
पट-मंडप m. a tent.
पट-वाप m. a tent.
पट-वेश्मन् n. a tent.
पट-वास m. 1. a tent; 2. a petticoat; 3. perfumed powder.
पट-वासक m. perfumed powder.
पटक n. A camp, an encampment.
पाटक m. 1. A splitter, a divider; 2. part of a village; 3. loss of capital; 4. a kind of musical instrument; 5. a bank, a shore; 6. a flight of steps leading to water; 7. throwing dice.
पटच्चर (I) m. A thief. Cf. पाटच्चर.
पटच्चर (II) n. Old or ragged clothes.
पाटच्चर m. A thief, a robber, पद्मिनीपरिमलालिपाटच्चरैर्मारुतैः Bh.V.ii.75.
पटत्क m. A thief.
पटपटा ind. An imitative sound.

पटल (I) n. 1. A roof, a thatch, दार्भं मुंचत्युटजपटलं वीतनिद्रो मयूरः Sak.iv.; 2. a cover, a veil, a coating; 3. a film over the eyes; 4. a basket; 5. a heap, a mass, a quantity, a multitude, धूपायतीव पटलैर्नवनीरदानाम् Sis.iv.52, R.iv.63; 6. retinue.
पटल (II) m. A tree.
पटल (III) m.n. A chapter of a book.
पटला f. See पटल (5).
पाटल (I) a. (f. ला) Pale red, of a palered colour, अग्रे स्त्रीनखपाटलं कुरबकम् Vikr.ii., R.ii.29, i.83, vii.27.
पाटल (II) m. 1. The pale-red colour, e.g. कपोलपाटलादेशि बभूव रघुचेष्टितम् R.iv.68; 2. the trumpet-flower, पाटलसंसर्गिसुरभिवनावाताः Sak.i.
पाटल (III) n. 1. The blossom of this tree, R.xvi.52, xix.46; 2. rice; 3. saffron.
पाटल (I) a. (f. ला) Pale red, of a palered colour, अग्रे स्त्रीनखपाटलं कुरबकम् Vikr.ii., R.ii.29, i.83, vii.27.
पाटला f. 1. The red lodhra; 2. the trumpet-flower (either the tree or its blossom); 3. an epithet of Durgā.
पटल-प्रांत m. the edge of a roof.
पटह m. 1. A kettle-drum, a tabor, कुर्वन् संध्याबलिपटहतां शूलिनः श्लाघनीयाम् Megh.i.34, R.ix.71; 2. noise or uproar of the battle; 3. beginning, undertaking; 4. injuring, killing.
पटह-भ्रमण n. going about with a drum to call people together.
पटालुका f. A leech.
पटि f. 1. Cloth; 2. the curtain of a stage; 3. a screen of a cloth surrounding a tent.
पटि f. 1. Cloth; 2. the curtain of a stage; 3. a screen of a cloth surrounding a tent.
पाटी f. Arithmetic.
पटि-क्षेप m. tossing aside the curtain of the stage. (As a stage-direction, it denotes a hurried and precipitate entrance on the stage.) See अपटीक्षेप.
पटि-क्षेप m. tossing aside the curtain of the stage. (As a stage-direction, it denotes a hurried and precipitate entrance on the stage.) See अपटीक्षेप.
पटिमन् m. 1. Dexterity, cleverness; 2. acidity; 3. harshness.
पटीर (I) m. 1. Sandal wood; 2. a ball for playing with; 3. the god of love.
पटीर (II) n. 1. Catechu; 2. the belly; 3. a sieve; 4. a field.
पाटीर m. 1. Sandal, पाटीर तव पटीयान् कः परिपाटीमिमामुरीकर्तुम् Bh.V.i.12; 2. a field; 3. tin.

पटु (I) a. (f. टु or ट्वी; compar. पटीयस्; super. पटिष्ठ) 1. Clever, dexterous, skilful (generally with a loc.); 2. sharp, pungent, acid; 3. smart, sharp; 4. healthy; 5. harsh, cruel, hard-hearted; 6. crafty, cunning, roguish; 7. clever; 8. sharp, sharp-sounding, clear-sounding, पटुपटहध्वनिभिर्विनीतनिद्रः R.ix.71, 73; 9. eloquent, पटुचाटुशतैरनुकूलम् Git.G.ii.; 10. blown, expanded.
पटु (II) m.n. A mushroom.
पटु (III) n. Salt.

पटु (I) a. (f. टु or ट्वी; compar. पटीयस्; super. पटिष्ठ) 1. Clever, dexterous, skilful (generally with a loc.); 2. sharp, pungent, acid; 3. smart, sharp; 4. healthy; 5. harsh, cruel, hard-hearted; 6. crafty, cunning, roguish; 7. clever; 8. sharp, sharp-sounding, clear-sounding, पटुपटहध्वनिभिर्विनीतनिद्रः R.ix.71, 73; 9. eloquent, पटुचाटुशतैरनुकूलम् Git.G.ii.; 10. blown, expanded.
पटोल n. A sort of cloth.
पटोलक m. An oyster.
पट्ट-अर्हा f. the principal queen.
पट्ट-उपाध्याय m. a writer of royal grants and other documents.
पट्ट-ज n. a sort of cloth.
पट्ट-देवी, -महिषी, -राज्ञी f. the principal queen.
पट्ट-देवी, -महिषी, -राज्ञी f. the principal queen.
पट्ट-देवी, -महिषी, -राज्ञी f. the principal queen.
पट्ट-वस्त्र, -वासस् a. attired in coloured cloth.
पट्ट-वस्त्र, -वासस् a. attired in coloured cloth.
पट्टन n. A city.
पाटन n. Splitting, breaking, cutting to pieces.
पट्टनी f. A city.
पट्टिका f. 1. A tablet, a plate; 2. a document; 3. a piece of cloth; 4. a piece of silk cloth; 5. bandage.
पट्टिका-वायक m. a silk-weaver.
पट्टिश(स) m. A spear with a sharp edge, भुजभ्रमितपट्टिशोद्दलितदृप्तदंतावलं भवंतमरिमंडलक्रथन पश्यतः संगरे Pr.
पट्टिश(स) m. A spear with a sharp edge, भुजभ्रमितपट्टिशोद्दलितदृप्तदंतावलं भवंतमरिमंडलक्रथन पश्यतः संगरे Pr.
पट्टिश(स) m. A spear with a sharp edge, भुजभ्रमितपट्टिशोद्दलितदृप्तदंतावलं भवंतमरिमंडलक्रथन पश्यतः संगरे Pr.
पट्टिश(स) m. A spear with a sharp edge, भुजभ्रमितपट्टिशोद्दलितदृप्तदंतावलं भवंतमरिमंडलक्रथन पश्यतः संगरे Pr.
पट्टोलिका f. A title-deed, a lease.
पाटल-उपल m. a ruby.
पाटल-द्रुम m. name of a tree. See पाटल
II.2
above.
पाटलि f. The trumpet-flower.

पाटलि-पुत्र n. name of an ancient city, the capital of Magadha, situated near the confluence of the Śoṇā and the Ganges, identified with the modern Pāṭnā. It is also known by the name of Pushpapura in Sanskrit literature. See R.vi.24, Mud.ii.111.
पाटलिक m. A pupil.
पाटल्या f. A multitude of pātāla flowers.
पाटव m. 1. Sharpness, acuteness; 2. cleverness, eloquence, पाटवं संस्कृतोक्तिषु Hit.i.; 3. quickness, rashness.
पाटविक a. (f. की) 1. Clever, skilful; 2. cunning, fraudulent.
पाटविक a. (f. की) 1. Clever, skilful; 2. cunning, fraudulent.
पाटित a. (f. ता) 1. Torn, split, broken; 2. pierced, R.xi.31.
पाटित a. (f. ता) 1. Torn, split, broken; 2. pierced, R.xi.31.
पाटी-गणित n. arithmetic.
